name: Bugged

angles.text: High Order mages found listening enchantments on ordinary skyhoppers, turning the seasonal swarm into a threat to Valanaar.

faq.answer: Skyhoppers are winged pests native to the lowlands around Valanaar. They swarm in great numbers during their seasonal surge.
Local cultists are suspected of placing listening spells on skyhoppers to eavesdrop on Valanaar.
Enchanted skyhoppers look just like ordinary insects. The whole swarm must be cleared to uncover and eliminate the spies.
faq.q: How do you tell which skyhoppers are enchanted?

faq.answer: The infestation and spying take place around Valanaar, an aerial city near the lowlands where seasonal swarms rise.

aliases: what spell is on the bugs
faq.answer: High Order mages found listening spells bound to slain skyhoppers. The enchantments turn them into roving watchers.
faq.q: What kind of enchantment was placed on the skyhoppers?

faq.answer: Enchanted skyhoppers cannot be distinguished from ordinary pests by sight. Clearing the swarms is necessary to purge the cult's listening posts and protect Valanaar.
faq.q: Why do all the skyhoppers need to be exterminated?

sections.body: When skyhopper season comes, lowland insects swarm around Valanaar. High Order mages inspected several slain skyhoppers and found listening enchantments on them. Local cultists are suspected of using the seasonal pests to eavesdrop on the city.
sections.title: Eavesdroppers in the Swarm

sections.body: The enchanted skyhoppers look like ordinary insects, so Valanaar's protectors must cull the whole swarm. Clearing them out denies the hostile cult intelligence and ends its magical surveillance of the city.
sections.title: Clearing the Air

summary: In Valanaar, seasonal skyhopper swarms now threaten the settlement. High Order mages found listening enchantments on slain insects, and local cultists are suspected of spying through them.
